original_media_proof: Each case binds its own complete prior-ProRes decode ledger and packet clock. No v1 renderer proof is fabricated or reused for these five cases.

writer_evidence.observed: ThreadedVideoWriter accepts bgra64le and encodes prores_ks profile4 yuva444p10le with709 color tags, no explicit conversion matrix filter. Runtime cutout separates RGB and alpha without premultiplication. Settings Cutout Linear=False and Frame Dir Linear=False. Legacy reviews use ffmpeg output pix_fmt rgba without matrix overrides.
writer_evidence.caveat: Current upstream code and historical settings are bound as local evidence, not a cryptographic historical-code snapshot. Actual MOV headers and default-decode controls are the direct media evidence.

cache_contract: Display-correct square-pixel RGB8 source and straight sRGB-convention RGBA8 prediction, linear alpha8. Explicit sRGB ancillary chunk on new caches declares their working display convention, not newly measured original footage colorimetry.

cases.title: Hair detail
cases.credit: Hollywood Camera Work / practice footage / results permitted
cases.temporal_mapping: original_index=floor(prepared_index*original_fps/24); source and prediction use identical original indices; no frame interpolation.
cases.color_convention: Preserve original PNG RGB code values and legacy FFmpeg-default decoded cutout display. Interpret those RGB values as sRGB for linear-light PAR correction; this is a display convention derived from Frame Dir Linear=False and Cutout Linear=False, not measured source primaries/transfer.
cases.source_metadata_caveat: PNG ancillary metadata is retained in the input snapshot; model image reader used cv2 RGB code values without ICC/gAMA conversion. In particular smoke has gAMA=1.0 but old model/review treated its code values with the sRGB display convention. This reuse preserves that convention rather than silently reinterpreting the old result.
cases.resampling: Horizontal PAR correction only; source linear-light Lanczos4. Cutout float32 sRGB EOTF -> premultiply linearRGB by linearalpha -> shared Lanczos4 resize -> clip coverage and premultiplied gamut -> unpremultiply -> sRGB OETF -> RGB8/alpha8. RGB zeroed where quantizedalpha=0. No straight-RGBA interpolation.
cases.precision_notes: Upstream bgra64le uint16 -> yuva444p10le -> ProRes4444 decoded yuva444p12le -> RGBA16 storage. Effective alpha is bounded by upstream10bit quantization, not16bit accuracy. Prepared cache is RGB8 + linear alpha8.
cases.cache_files_publication: LOCAL_ONLY: do not publish source_reuse or standalone original source assets; main publishes edited demonstration under original terms.
